_note: Everything that changes per site lives here, not in code. Adding a site means adding a block below and picking which adapter class it uses (by parent company). The bot reloads this on every cycle — no restart needed.

scheduler._note_stagger: Wait 45s between sites to look human. 80 sites × 45s = ~60 min for a full pass.
scheduler._note_timed: For sites like Fliff/Jefebet that allow claims every 2-6 hours.

anti_detection._note_fp: Each site gets its own persistent browser profile with a unique fingerprint (canvas, WebGL, navigator, audio, fonts). The fingerprint is stable per-site across runs (so the site sees the same 'device' each day) but unique per-site (so cross-site tracking can't link accounts).

proxy._note: Residential proxies are non-negotiable. Datacenter IPs are flagged instantly by sweepstakes sites. One sticky session per site per run.

credentials._note: Each site's email/password stored encrypted at rest. Decrypted only at runtime, only for the site being claimed. Never logged, never in plaintext on disk.

alerts._note_threshold: Alert when any site's balance hits its minimum redemption.

sites.name: McLuck
sites._note: Selectors discovered by inspecting the live site. These are the first thing that changes when the site updates — the adapter detects the break and alerts.

sites.name: Playfame
sites._note: Same B2 platform, same adapter, same selectors. Only the URL and credentials differ.

sites.name: Chumba Casino
sites._note_streak: VGW streak: bonus grows from $0.25 to $5 over 7 consecutive days. Missing a day resets to day 1. The adapter tracks which streak day we're on and flags a missed day.

selectors._note: Fliff requires phone login — the adapter uses the mobile viewport and handles the phone-number OTP flow.

_architecture_note: The adapter field maps to a Python class. All 6 B2 sites use B2Adapter. All 4 VGW sites use VGWAdapter. Each adapter knows the login flow, the daily bonus flow, and the balance check for its platform. When a site updates its UI, one selector fix in this config repairs all sites on that platform.
